status.label: Not ready: 1 class fails to load

summary: The code scanner finds little here, but loading every class on PHP 8.5.12 shows that App\Model\Report cannot be declared at all: its handle() signature is incompatible with the parent, which PHP 7 only warned about. One small fix, plus a return type for Counter::count().

notes.title: Report::handle() is incompatible with Base::handle()
notes.body: The child requires an extra parameter. PHP 7.4 loaded the class with a warning; PHP 8.0+ refuses to declare it (fatal), so every request that touches Report fails. Make the extra parameter optional.

code.note: Loads without a warning on 7.4 and 8.5.12; callers that pass $format are unchanged.

evidence.title: PHP 8.0 migration: backward incompatible changes
evidence.quote: Inheritance errors due to incompatible method signatures (LSP violations) will now always generate a fatal error. Previously a warning was generated in some cases.

evidence.title: RFC: Always generate fatal error for incompatible method signatures

notes.title: Countable::count() without return type
notes.body: PHP 8.1 added a tentative return type to Countable::count(); without it every load emits E_DEPRECATED.

evidence.title: PHP 8.1 migration: tentative return types
evidence.quote: a ReturnTypeWillChange attribute can be added to silence the deprecation notice.

notes.title: Unresolved classes are not PHP problems
notes.body: Plugin extends a class from a package that is not installed, and Optional refuses to load without acme/missing. Install those packages (or ignore the classes) before drawing conclusions about them.
